environment.description: Lambda deployed within an isolated VPC (10.0.0.0/16) with no NAT gateway and no internet gateway attached. Outbound connectivity is provided exclusively through a set of VPC Endpoints: com.amazonaws.us-east-1.execute-api (Interface type), com.amazonaws.us-east-1.s3 (Gateway type), and com.amazonaws.us-east-1.dynamodb (Gateway type). DNS resolution within the VPC is handled by Route 53 Resolver with a forwarding rule that sends all queries to an on-premises DNS resolver at 10.0.1.53 which only resolves internal *.corp.local zones and AWS service endpoints (*.amazonaws.com). The Lambda security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) allows egress only to the VPC endpoint ENIs on port 443 and to 10.0.1.53 on port 53. No egress rule permits traffic to 169.254.169.254/32 or any public IP range. The VPC endpoint policy on execute-api restricts invocation to the specific API Gateway ID only.

config.route53_resolver: forwarding rule to 10.0.1.53 for all zones; resolver only returns results for *.corp.local and *.amazonaws.com
config.imds_note: Lambda runtime metadata service at 169.254.169.254 exists but security group has no egress rule permitting traffic to link-local range
